Package com.privatechain.network.rpc

Class MessageCodec

java.lang.Object
com.privatechain.network.rpc.MessageCodec
public final class MessageCodec extends Object
Encodes and decodes wire-protocol messages exchanged between blockchain nodes.

MessageCodec is responsible for the serialization layer of the P2P protocol. All messages are framed as UTF-8 JSON with a type discriminator field. This makes the protocol human-readable and debuggable while meeting the portability requirements of the private-blockchain library.

Message format

Every message follows a simple envelope:


 {
   "type": "BLOCK",          // one of the MessageType enum values
   "senderId": "nodeId...",  // originating node ID
   "payload": { ... }        // type-specific JSON object
 }

Supported message types

  • MessageCodec.MessageType.BLOCK — a newly mined or propagated block
  • MessageCodec.MessageType.TRANSACTION — a submitted transaction
  • MessageCodec.MessageType.GET_STATUS — request for a peer's chain height
  • MessageCodec.MessageType.STATUS — response carrying a peer's chain height
  • MessageCodec.MessageType.GET_BLOCKS — request for blocks in a height range
  • MessageCodec.MessageType.PING — heartbeat request
  • MessageCodec.MessageType.PONG — heartbeat response

Thread safety

Jackson's ObjectMapper is thread-safe after configuration; this class is safe for concurrent use by multiple threads.

Since:
1.0.0

  • Constructor Details

    • MessageCodec

      public MessageCodec()
      Constructs a MessageCodec with a pre-configured ObjectMapper.

      The mapper is configured to:

      • Serialize Instant via the JavaTimeModule
      • Disable SerializationFeature.WRITE_DATES_AS_TIMESTAMPS so timestamps appear as ISO-8601 strings
